dialogues.speaker: Yellowed Records
dialogues.text: "...I did not expect the fae [...] so adaptable. Could it be because the Hyperboreans had left some kind of access point behind when they first created them...?"

dialogues.speaker: Yellowed Records
dialogues.text: "A body formed from trees can regrow after being damaged, and also grant the subject strength far beyond that of their original body. However, its language capabilities will regress..."

dialogues.speaker: Yellowed Records
dialogues.text: "After all, there's not much pain to speak of anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Yellowed Records
dialogues.text: "The experiments conducted in the sewers have yielded sufficient data. Now, we must find a way to slowly make the townspeople accept this..."

dialogues.speaker: Yellowed Records
dialogues.text: "Certainly, once they see the 'treatment' Furiosa has undergone, there will always be some poor souls tormented by illness who will want to try it out for themselves..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The patient's name is... Furiosa!? Isn't she the one we just saw on the bridge...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So he's the one behind all this! First, he tried to change Furiosa in the sewers, then he turned everyone else into tree monsters... No, no, into the "Perfect Tree" or whatever!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: When we find him, Paimon's gonna teach him a real good lesson!

dialogues.speaker: Control Guide (II)
dialogues.text: ...inserting either the Iron Key or the Silver Key into the recess can lower the water level... inserting both the Iron Key and the Silver Key will discharge the water entirely...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... They keep going on and on about "lowering the water level" here. There must be something in that water.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So we'll need the <color=#00E1FFFF>Iron Key</color> here, too! We've got to think of a way to retrieve the one inside then...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... What a pain. Seriously, why would anyone put such a complicated mechanism down here in the sewers...

dialogues.speaker: Okurov Town Water Conservation Schematics
dialogues.text: ...excavation of a main channel below... construct a chamber... control the reservoir by means of keys made of gold, silver, and iron... discharge standing water from the valley...
